lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spots exhibit a regular spatial distribution with larger diameters located towards the mid-flank and smaller diameters moving dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a rectilinear grid-like structure where spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated high-luminance feature is visible trailing immediately ventral to the pectoral fin, contrasting with the lower-intensity background pixels.
